description: This file declares the SetPosition class, which is a task for setting the playback position in a generic media player context within the Rialto server component. It includes class members, constructor, destructor, and an execute method, along with necessary includes and namespace encapsulation.

classes.name: SetPosition
classes.description: A class representing a task to set the media playback position in the Rialto server's generic player context.

methods.name: SetPosition
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the SetPosition task with the given context, player, client, wrapper, and position.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task to set the media position.
